master.definition_en: A melanoma derived from melanocytes of the uveal tract. It is the most common primary intraocular tumor in the United States and Western Europe. Similar to melanoma of the skin, it is rare in Africa and Asia. Diagnostic procedures include ophthalmoscopic exam, fluorescein angiography and ultrasound. Treatment includes: surgical excision of the eye, iridocyclectomy and tumor resection. Recent treatments also include radiotherapy or photo coagulation. Classification of uveal melanomas recognizes four cell types within these tumors: epithelioid, intermediate, mixed cell, and spindle cell types. The spindle cell type uveal melanomas are further sub-classified as spindle cell type A and spindle cell type B.

curated.category: 恶性与内分泌功能性肿瘤 / 肾上腺神经内分泌肿瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 极具隐匿杀伤力的“定时炸弹”！约85%–90%呈良性生物学行为，但因阵发性或持续性狂飙释放大量肾上腺素/去甲肾上腺素，可因按压腹部、排尿、麻醉诱导或情绪激动在数分钟内诱发恶性高血压危象（收缩压>250mmHg）、急性脑出血、主动脉夹层、儿茶酚胺心肌病/Takotsubo心衰或室颤猝死；约10%–15%为转移性恶性嗜铬细胞瘤。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 良性局限性嗜铬细胞瘤（约85%）在充分术前α受体阻滞剂准备后行腹腔镜手术完整切除即可彻底治愈，血压恢复正常；即使10%–15%发生骨/肝/肺转移，肿瘤生长多较缓慢，依托放射性核素治疗、CVD化疗或HIF-2α/TKI靶向，5年生存率仍可达50%–70%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN未单列嗜铬细胞瘤；全球年发病率约2–8/百万人口（0.2–0.8/10万），约40%病例与遗传性胚系突变相关（所有肿瘤中遗传比例最高之一）
annual_deaths_global.source: Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline / Orphanet ORPHA:276624

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 突发儿茶酚胺高血压危象（剧烈头痛、大汗淋漓、心悸、面色苍白、血压飙升）：【绝对避坑铁律】严禁在未充分使用α受体阻滞剂前单独使用β受体阻滞剂（如美托洛尔/普萘洛尔），否则会因阻断血管β2舒张受体导致α受体无拮抗缩血管，引发致死性血压反跳飙升及急性肺水肿！应立即静脉泵入酚妥拉明(Phentolamine)或乌拉地尔/硝普钠扩血管，待α阻滞充分后再谨慎加用艾司洛尔控制心动过速; 2) 严禁对未排除嗜铬细胞瘤的肾上腺肿物盲目行穿刺活检（可诱发致命危象）; 3) 肿瘤切除瞬间警惕血压骤降及严重低血糖，需提前扩容及备好去甲肾上腺素。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 所有确诊患者（无论年龄与家族史）强烈推荐行SDHx(SDHB/SDHD/SDHC)、VHL、RET、NF1、TMEM127、MAX胚系基因检测，并对突变携带者一级亲属开展级联筛查与终生生化/MRI随访
术前充分高盐饮食与补液扩容（防术后顽固性低血压），达标后再行微创腹腔镜/机器人切除

所有患者术后均需终生每年复查血浆游离甲氧基肾上腺素(MNs)预防复发或异时性转移

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 首个随机双盲2期试验FIRSTMAPPP证实舒尼替尼用于进展期恶性PPGL显著改善12个月无进展生存率(35.9% vs 18.9%，Lancet 2024); 2) 口服HIF-2α抑制剂贝组替凡(Belzutifan)在LITESPARK-015研究（针对VHL及SDHx假缺氧通路驱动的PPGL）展示出高疾病控制率，有望成为首个靶向假缺氧通路的精准新药; 3) 68Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT显著提升转移灶检出灵敏度，并指导177Lu-DOTATATE肽受体放射性核素治疗。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 转移性恶性嗜铬细胞瘤目前尚无彻底治愈手段，传统化疗与靶向缓解持久度有限; 2) 良恶性在初次手术病理上无法绝对区分（须靠转移发生才能确诊恶性），亟需精准分子转移预测标志物; 3) 基层误诊为普通原发性高血压并在全麻手术中诱发未准备危象仍时有发生。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑

master.definition_en: Paraquat poisoning is a rare intoxication with paraquat (a non-selective bipyridilium herbicide that has been banned in Europe), usually occurring through ingestion of the poison, and that presents with caustic injury of the oral cavity and pharynx, as well as nausea, vomiting, epigastric pain, lethargy, loss of consciousness and fever. Intoxication via inhalation, injection and dermal or mucus contact have also been reported.

master.definition_en: A group of anomalies presented in infants as a result of in utero exposure (between 20-36 days after fertilization) to thalidomide, a sedative used in treatment of a range of conditions, including morning sickness, leprosy and multiple myeloma (see these terms). Thalidomine embryopathy is characterized by phocomelia, amelia, forelimb and hand plate anomalies (absence of humerus and/or forearm, femur and/or lower leg, thumb anomalies). Other anomalies include facial hemangiomas, and damages to ears (anotia, microtia), eyes (microphthalmia, anophthalmos, coloboma, strabismus), internal organs (kidney, heart, and gastrointestinal tract), genitalia, and heart. Infant mortality associated with thalidomide embryopathy is estimated to be as high as 40%. Thalidomide is contraindicated in pregnancy and pregnancy prevention is recommended in women under treatment.

master.definition_en: Acquired fructose intolerance is a condition in which the body can not properly absorb the sugar, fructose. As a result, affected people may experience gastrointestinal symptoms, such as gas, abdominal pain, bloating and/or diarrhea, depending on the quantity of fructose consumed and the presence of other sugars ingested with it. Gastrointestinal symptoms related to acquired fructose intolerance appear to be more common in people who have an underlying functional bowel disorder such as irritable bowel syndrome. The underlying cause of the condition is poorly understood. It is distinct from the rare, genetic form of fructose intolerance (called hereditary fructose intolerance), which usually develops earlier in life and often affects more than one family member. Acquired fructose intolerance is generally managed with dietary modifications.

Affected individuals have focal aware seizures with mesial temporal lobe features, especially prominent déjà vu. Most patients have a normal MRI, and seizures respond to treatment. A subgroup is recognised that have antecedent febrile seizures, hippocampal atrophy, and drug resistant seizures. master.name_en: T-cell based immunotherapy-associated cytokine release syndrome
master.definition_en: A rare systemic condition affecting patients undergoing chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy and characterized by a systemic inflammatory response due to massive activation of leukocytes with subsequent cytokine release. It can present with a variety of signs and symptoms ranging from mild, flu-like symptoms (such as fever, fatigue, headache, rash, arthralgia, and myalgia) to severe life-threatening manifestations including vascular leakage, disseminated intravascular coagulation, shock, and multiple organ failure. Respiratory manifestations are common and range from cough and tachypnea to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS).
